task.title: Task Create/Edit web view UI Tweaks
task.description:
- In the new task create view, there's no field for assigning someone to the task, you have to save the task first. Assignment should be available as part of creation.
 - After a task has been created and you go to edit it, the layout is different from create in that the additional fields for assignment and attachments are rendered full width below the description box, instead of on the right-hand sidebar along with dependencies. There's no reason to make this change and it it's a good use of space. The only elements that should be below the description+Save button are comments and the task history
 - For attaching files, there's no need to render the Add file button before a file has been attached, instead after a file has been chosen the Choose Files button can change to Add file.
 - There's no way to undo choosing a file add. After a file has been chosen, a user should be able to remove it before adding by clicking a red X button next to the file name. If all pending attachments are removed, the "Add file" button reverts back to "Choose files"
 - The task dependency inputs in the sidebar should be positioned above attachments, they're more frequently used
 - When adding "Assignment" to the sidebar, it should go below dependencies but above attachments
 - Remove the "Nothing staged / Nothing is staged. Anything added here is attached once the task is created." reminder text for Attachments. It isn't necessary.
 - In the new task header, delete the large "Add work to the board" heading and shrink the header to a smaller band with just the "New task" text.
 -  Add a "X" button to the right of the header that closes and cancels the new task creation (same function as Back)
 - In the New task footer, change the "Back" link to "Cancel" and move it to the right side of the footer. Move the "Create more" checkbox down in line with the Save button, and move the actual checkbox to the right of the "Create more" text
 - Change the description "Done" button to "Preview"
